Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking a look — I'm Sophia, program lead for Brookside Community Lab (community-run makerspace + oral-history archive). We're running a small pilot to build a searchable archive of locally recorded community oral histories (audio files, consented public). The team is three people and we're operating on a shoestring budget.

Would Redwood consider providing promo credits or an extension of the standard trial so we can run a month-long eval of your transcription + embedding flow (batch transcription, speaker diarization, and short-context retrieval)? Specifically we're asking for: a 3-month trial window and ~50k token-equivalent credits to cover transcription runs and embedding index costs.

I've attached a brief pilot proposal that outlines the dataset, evaluation plan, and intended community outcomes. We're a registered nonprofit (EIN 12-3456789) and can provide incorporation docs if needed.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that's easier. Our timeline is tight: community showcase is in late October and we'd like to have preliminary results by mid-September.

Best,
Sophia Ramos
Program Lead, Brookside Community Lab
